description: Copy a card with its tasks, labels and members (attachments are not copied). Lands in the same column unless listId says otherwise. Re-reads the copy and reports what it carries.

boardId.description: Board for the copy, when copying across boards. Requires listId.

listId.description: Column for the copy. Defaults to the original's column.

name.description: Name for the copy. Without it Planka appends its own suffix to the original name.

name: planka_duplicate_card
title: Duplicate card
